sections.title: War Experience
content: Served during the war
Awarded Petrov Order for merit during wartime
Experienced the Iron Army invasion firsthand
Lived through Vuk's regime and its fall

sections.title: Post-War Life
content: Became detective in Regional Police during rebuilding
Partnered with Sek Yurity after the war
Represents the Native perspective in law enforcement
Embodies the possibility of integration and coexistence

coreTraits: Believes in working within the system
Strong sense of justice and fairness
Loyal but questions when loyalty conflicts with principle
motivations: Proving the system can work for everyone
Maintaining law and order through legitimate means
Protecting both Natives and Conquerors equally
Upholding the integration promised by the Accords
internalConflicts: Tension between following rules and delivering justice
Frustration when the system fails (corrupt judges, framed colleagues)
Questions whether Sek truly serves everyone or just 'his people'

details: Detective partner and friend since after the war
Share whiskey ritual - moment of bonding across their differences
Deep mutual respect but fundamental disagreements
Veckurius challenges Sek to be better
Defends her from slurs at the police station
Represents his belief in protecting everyone, not just his own
Becomes disillusioned when Judge Muliera obstructs justice
Forced to compromise his principles by enabling Sek's operation

sections.title: Act I - Belief in the System
content: Investigates alongside Sek professionally
Follows proper procedures
Defends Peni Tenz from discrimination
Represents 'doing it the right way'

sections.title: Act II - Frustration and Breaking
content: Realizes Rydeovich is being framed by corrupt system
Clashes with Judge Muliera
Conducts unauthorized gang raids out of frustration
Doesn't yet know Zekovich is behind everything

sections.title: Act III - Moral Compromise
content: Confronts Sek about only protecting Conquerors
Forces Sek to articulate his choice
Must decide: report Sek's special forces operation or enable it
Chooses to enable it - crosses the line himself
Carries the guilt of compromise

characterArc.before: Believes the system can deliver justice if good people work within it
characterArc.after: Understands sometimes the law isn't enough; shares Sek's moral burden

notableMoments.description: Defends Peni Tenz from slurs, establishes his principles
Shares whiskey with Sek at motel (bonding ritual)
Confronts Sek about loyalties - 'You only protect your people'
Enables the special forces operation, becomes complicit

storySignificance: Represents Native perspective and voice of integration
His arc mirrors Sek's - both compromise their principles
Embodies the tension between law and justice
The whiskey ritual symbolizes their bond despite differences

thematicRole.description: Challenges Sek to work within the system

nextBook: Shares the secret of the special forces operation with Sek
Their partnership is now based on mutual compromise and guilt
The whiskey ritual takes on new meaning - two men who crossed lines they can't uncross
